create_unit_for_assignment: create a Unit for a given assignment using Unit.new with index and pay amount
get_unit_status: get the current status of a Unit by calling get_status to check worker progress
launch_unit_on_crowd_provider: launch a Unit on the crowdsourcing vendor by calling launch with a task URL
expire_unit_from_vendor: expire a Unit to remove it from the vendor and return the wait time needed
clear_assigned_agent_from_unit: clear the assigned agent from a Unit and reset its status back to LAUNCHED
